description.narrative: Being a young female politician in Zambia means facing resistance, discrimination, intimidation and sexism due to pervasive cultural and patriarchical norms. The YOWOP project aims at equipping Young Female Politicians in Zambia with tools required to challenge stereotypes and overcome capacity gaps and lack of opportunities to participate in their country's development. By the creation of a safe space where YFP can exchange with their peers, by amplyfying their voices and broadcasting their stories and by connecting YFP with senior women political activits to bridge the knowledge gap, YOWOP is poised to bring about change. A collaboration between CYLA and Green Forum, YOWOP will benefit from already existing technical platforms, an established network with the target group, and most importantly, a shared passion for youth empowerment and social justice.

Ett kapacitetsstärkande projekt som riktar sig till unga kvinnliga politiker i Zambia för att ge dem verktyg och kunskap i bl a säker navigering på nätet och öka deras möjligheter att vara med och påverka landets framtid. Ska koppla ihop unga kvinnliga politiker med mer erfarna kvinnliga politiker och etablera ett mentorsskapsprogram.
